note: Both sets cover the same five distinct facts (40W incandescent, 9W compact fluorescent, 7W LED, the T24 high-efficacy requirement for HARVEST HOME fixtures, and the vacancy-sensor bypass requirement) and both are heavily padded with duplicate claims. Set A is more faithful on the bulb wattages, keeping the stated condition that the 9W CFL and 7W LED give light output equivalent to the 40W incandescent, and its quotes are fuller. Set B's vacancy-sensor claim invents a condition ('when connected to luminaires with dimmer switches') not stated in the text and states the requirement only vaguely ('must be able to bypass'), dropping the complete-disconnect outcome. Both sets omit the Title 24 own-switch requirement for kitchen, bathroom, closet and laundry rooms and the lighting-levels table.
